findings.reason: the worker must import back every moved name that staying code calls, not only the public ones, so §2 needs one clause naming `_lift_history` (or keeping it in `budget.py`); otherwise the section's own gate fails for a reason the plan's mechanism, read literally, cannot avoid.
findings.text: §2 moves `_lift_history` out of `budget.py` (§2's §"The cut" list, line 44: "the lift-reading helpers: `_other_session_lift`, `_lift_label`, `_lift_resolved_config`, `_lift_history`, …") while stating on line 56 that "`budget.py` imports the moved public names from `reckon/pace_report.py` at module level, so they stay real bindings in `reckon.budget`"; but at `76946f9a9` `preflight` (`reckon/budget.py:2096`) calls it by bare name inside its own module — `readings=_lift_history(pace_records, members=set(members), reading=reading, moment=moment)` at `reckon/budget.py:2181` — and `_lift_history` is private, so on the plan's own wording it is not among the names imported back, leaving the name unresolved in `budget.py`'s namespace and preflight raising `NameError`

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — §8 of `every-module-fits-a-worker-window` says textually what §2 now quotes ("A produced module never imports the original at module level. An unavoidable back-reference uses the function-level import this codebase already uses for cycles."); `reckon/crew/budget_lift.py` holds `SESSION_PREFIX` (`:99`), `list_lifts` (`:537`) and `effective_budget` (`:553`) at `76946f9a9` as §2's new attribution claims; `f-lamr-053` exists and is open in `lane-and-model-routing`; the extensionless href `/reckon/every-module-fits-a-worker-window` resolves as `<path>.html`.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §2's done-when is a token bound measured by the guard it names (`tests/test_every_module_fits_a_worker_window.py` at the node's head, `reckon/budget.py` ≤ 45,000 tokens), and its negative control restores `budget.py`'s base content in a scratch copy and requires the width test to name it again.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the section writes no evidence into a scratchpad; its gate is a test file run at the node's head and its record lands on the run's own manifest and logs under `~/.config/reckon/crew/runs/`, which survive the run.
rubric_items.naming: pass — §2's new text names mechanisms (`pace_report`, the record owner `crew/budget_lift.py`) and carries no plan label, ticket id or changelog prose.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — the flipped import direction keeps preflight's bare-name calls working for the moved *public* names only, while a private moved helper that preflight itself calls by bare name is left with no binding.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §2 carries one deliverable: the pace and lift family moves out of `reckon/budget.py` so that module fits the worker window.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — `plan-section-depends-on` gives s2 the edge `lane-and-model-routing#s46`, and the reciprocal edge resolves: `docs/plans/lane-and-model-routing.html` carries `"s48":["lane-and-model-routing#s46","budget-fits-a-worker-window#s2"]`, matching §2's Sequence paragraph.
